debt noun

Cic. Cat. 2.9: in aes aliēnum incidere, to fall into debt (Lewis & Short s.v. aes)

Traupman 301

aes aliēnum

Other words

  • dēbitum, dēbitī n. — a sum owed

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Lewis & Short s.v. dēbeō; Traupman 131: to pay off a debt, dēbitum persolvere

Examples

  • Hoc mihi aes aliēnum attulit.

    This has put me in debt.Traupman 130

  • dēbitum persolvere

    to pay off a debtTraupman 131

  • in aere aliēnō esse

    to be in debtTraupman 301

  • aes aliēnum cōnflāre

    to run up debtsTraupman 373

  • aes aliēnum grande cōnflāre

    to run up a huge debtSall. C. 14.2 (Lewis & Short s.v. cōnflō)

See also buy on credit, bill.
